text:
maria: Thinking about a new pattern for SIEM exports for analytics. Proposal: raw event exports only 30d TTL, anonymized/aggregated metrics exported for 3 years. Need a recommended KMS strategy for export bundles and an RBAC sketch for who can request/download. Any concerns from sec or platform?
omar: +1 on shorter raw retention. Strong rec: never export raw PII >30d. For KMS I'd use per-export ephemeral DEKs (GenerateDataKey) and wrap the DEK with a dedicated export CWK that we rotate yearly. That way we can revoke at key-level if needed. Also require export metadata to include approving ticket id.
liam: We can front exports with an export-proxy service so we centralize approval checks, watermarking, and audit captures. Proxy would: verify Jira/Ticket, sign export manifest, call KMS to wrap DEK, store manifest in audit store, and push bundle to secure S3. Example manifest header to embed in zip: ```
export_meta: {
  "approved_ticket": "JIRA-XXXX",
  "approved_by": "maria",
  "kms_key": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/exports/cryptoKeys/exp-2026",
  "ttl_secs": 2592000
}
```
maria: Nice. Can we support just-in-time (JIT) unmasking for analysts? e.g., someone requests decrypt, approval window 8h, unwrap event logged and key use audited.
omar: JIT unmasking ok but limit to scoped roles. Suggested RBAC: role:siem_export_requester (can request export), role:siem_export_approver (can approve + trigger wrap), role:siem_export_consumer (can download decrypted bundle within approved window). Every unwrap requires a justification string and creates an immutable audit entry with requestor, approver, ticket, and KMS unwrap event id. :lock: 
audit-bot: Export request recorded: ticket=JIRA-5132 export_id=exp-20260317-01 status=pending reviewer=role:siem_export_approver
liam: I'll prototype the proxy and a minimal terraform module for the KMS key + IAM bindings. Plan: open PR to eng-infra, include migration playbook for existing exports, and add a compliance checklist. Ping me when you want the PR linked to the ticket.
maria: Thanks — please include sample alerting on repeated unwraps for same dataset (anomaly). We'll loop in compliance for retention acceptance. :eyes:
